content.title: Lakers vs. Pacers: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/25/26)
content.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (46–26) face the Indiana Pacers (16–56) tonight at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis. The Lakers enter after seeing their nine-game winning streak snapped in a narrow 113–110 loss to the Detroit Pistons, despite Luka Doncic’s 32-point performance in a game decided late. Los Angeles stormed back in the third quarter from a 16-point deficit, but could not close out the win. Austin Reaves scored 24 points on 7-of-15 shooting, while LeBron James added 12 points and 10 assists, finishing just one rebound short of a triple-double. Doncic is the primary catalyst of L.A.’s surge, with Reaves as the key secondary scorer. But James has also been impactful, with his efficiency rising as his usage rate declines — serving as a critical facilitator in the Lakers’ offense. Indiana, meanwhile, snapped a record 16-game losing streak with a 128–126 victory over the Orlando Magic on Monday, powered by a 37-point performance by Pascal Siakam, who also blocked a shot by Paolo Banchero in the final seconds to seal the win. Jarace Walker added 20 points and Aaron Nesmith scored 19 as the Pacers shot 55% from the field. The Pacers are lottery-bound, while the Lakers remain in third place in the Western Conference, out of contention for first place, but with a 1.5-game lead over the fourth-place Denver Nuggets. Tonight’s matchup should help L.A. fend off Denver and others as they look to bolster control over the third seed. Indiana has shown it’s capable of securing wins against top-tier opponents occassionaly, but other than Siakam, the supporting cast has been far from consistent. Expect a comfortable double-digit win for Los Angeles. Final Score Prediction: Los Angeles Lakers 122, Indiana Pacers 112 Injury Report Los Angeles Lakers Deandre Ayton — GTD (Back) Adou Thiero — Out (Knee) Marcus Smart — Out (Ankle) Rui Hachimura — Out (Calf) Nick Smith Jr. — GTD (Undisclosed) Indiana Pacers Obi Toppin — GTD (Foot) Andrew Nembhard — GTD (Triceps) Aaron Nesmith — GTD (Ankle) Pascal Siakam — GTD (Knee) Ivica Zubac — OFS (Rib) Johnny Furphy — OFS (ACL) Tyrese Haliburton — OFS (Achilles) How to Watch Lakers vs. Pacers Tip-off for tonight’s Lakers-Pacers game is set for 7:00 PM Eastern / 4:00 PM Pacific at the Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.
